content: Ayyana minthathonnee Ayye
Ye wode gaame mukuler taybinttiza asay wolalli afa yedhdhinttod gatho asii asal afa shiiqii yezin, Yesuusa fa tamaaritayiko, «Ferisaawitay irshshopp naaginitoytta. Yeyikka cubbotith.
Benttekka qosinttii, erinttekka kamintti attizibaz akkokka baaya.
Yikkee, yi dhuma odeezibazay ubbay poo7o si7inttoda, qol7a haye kalkkasheez baz woyas odinttoda.
«Ta bagguntho, ta odiza si7oytta; asho wodhizapp attin hara abikka oothodayis danda7oozittayis yashittippate.
Hano zin, yi yashittodayis beezizana ta yinttis beessada. Yeykka wodheezayppe guye Gaanname olodayis mawute yezayis ezis yashittooytta. Ee, tuma giza; ezis yashittooytta.
Ichchin suunnitay pettii santifess bayizinttoosannee? Hanopp attin unttapp pettatakka Xooss tiina doginttenna.
Hara attozin, yi ooma binanaykka payidinttii yeza. Yikkee, yashittippate; gaame suunnitaypp yi aadhiza.
«Ta odiza si7oytta; as tiina ta baz markkattiz ubbayis As Na7ay Xooss kiitanchchitay tiina markkottoda.
As tiina tana kaddizana Xooss kiitanchchitay tiina ta eza kaddoda.
As Na7al afa leqo qaala odiz ubbitay maarotithi demmada, zin geeshsha Ayyana cazhizitay maarinttenna.
«Asii yinttan aykkii Ayihuditay Woosa Keetha, daynnitay tiinannee kaatitay tiina gooshichchiza wode ab ododazakonnee waagii mahodazako hirigipatte.
Ye wode yi odod baz geeshsha Ayyanay yinttan tamarssoda» yeegeeza.
Dure athay boozetith
Woyitaypp pettii asii Yesuusako yi7ii, «Ta ishay taas nu aday keekepp shaakkod garkk ezis odoba» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa mahii, «Naat athayyo, yinttal afa tana daynninnee keeke shaakkiz cima ootheezay oonoo?» yeegeeza.
Maakka Yesuusa, «As yessay shalo gaametithar baazay gishos yaare ashshii miinthii yinttan naagoytta» yeegeeza.
Maaqqikka aazisor, «Gaday gaame katha inggiz pettii dure athay yeza.
Ye athay, ‹Ta katha taanii shiishodayis aqo xiqqeez gishos ab ootho?› yeegii fa wozinar qoppeeza.
Yhanppe yessada; tiin yeza shaalita hullii hara dalgge shaale keexxoda. Kathannee taas yeza baz ubba ezayid oloda.
Fa shemppatiko, ‹Ta shemppate, gaame laythis nees gidiza shalo shiisheeza. Yikkee, shempp mooba, uzhoba, ufayttoba› yeegoda.
«Zin Xoossay, ‹Naat, boozo athayyo, yhayino qamma ne shemppata neepp ekinttiza. Yikkee, ne shiisheezay ooss maaqqode?› yeegeeza.
«Yey gishos, paas duretithii sa7all shiishiza asis, Xooss kale dure maaqqekka asis wurssithay yha athayisaygarkke» yeegeeza.
Un77inttippatte
Yeyppe guye, Yesuusa fa tamaaritayiko, «Yikkee, ta odiza baz si7oytta, yi shemppos ab maadee yi gallas ab ma77odee yeegii un77inttippate.
Shemppo kathapp galla afilapp aadhiza.
Kafita bo7oytta zerooya, maxooya, shaalekka baaya. Zin Xoossay unttan muziza. Yi kafitaypp lo7ithii aadhiza.
Hano zin, yinttipp un77inttii fa laythal afa pettii qamma gujjodayis danda7izay oonoo?
Yikkee, yha xiqqabaz oothodayis danda7oowa yi harabazis abis un77inttee?
An fudhitay wayizii diccizako bo7oytta. Waayooya suqqooya. Hara attozin, Solomone paas yeezii bonchcho ubbayir unttapp pettay garkkekka ma77ii be7ekkaya.
Yinttano, ammano pacceezitayyo, yikkee, Xoossay yhayino benttii wontta tama gancce wodhdhod fudhita yhay garkke ma7isiko, yinttan wayizii aathii ma7isoosa?
Yey gishos, ab moshsha woy ab uzhoshsha gi yi wozinar un77inttippate.
Ye ubba Xoossa ammanoowa asay koyiza. Zin yi aday Xoossay yey ubbitay yinttis koshshizana eriza.
Ubbapp aathii Xooss kaattetitha kozhoytta yey ubbitay yinttis gujjii inginttoda.
«Yinttano, xiqqa woyitayyo, yi aday Xoossay kaattetitha yinttis immadayis e lo77o shene maaqqeeza yashittippate.
Yinttis yeza baz bayizii manqqitayis inggoytta. Kayzo ekkowa, bila moowa aqo, cimowa qurbo gancce, wuroowa shalana salo shiishoytta.
Yi wozinay yi shalay yeza aqo maaqqada.
Barkkii naago
«Yi xeessay danccintteeza, yi xomppay poo7eeza maaqqo.
Fa goday bossaypp maaqqad gatho barkkii naagizitay garkk, goday yi7ii xeegiz wode ellis dooyodayis giigeez asita aazoytta.
Fa goday maaqqiz wode genttekkazar naagizitay anjjintteezita. Ta turo giza; goday haatar danccii leemmate lanqqayid bettithi mokkiza.
Goday giddii bilahe maaqqin woy wonttimaathe maaqqin yi7ii, yey garkk genttekazar naagodar denggiza ye ayllitay anjjintteezita.
Zin yhaya eroytta; kayizo ayide ye7odazako kara aday erizako keethay bokinttamizin.
Yinttikka giigii naagoytta; As Na7ay yi qoppekka wode ye7oda» yeegeeza.
Phixiroosakka, «Godayyo yha aazisa nu aaddas odinenee as ubbaso?» yeegeeza.
Goday mahii, «Yikkee, katha muzodayis beeziza woder immad garkk goday fa ayllitayil afa shuumeez ammanthizaynnee wozinaamay oonoo?
Goday maaqqodar yey garkk oothittar benttiz ayllay E anjjintteezaya
Ta yinttis turo odiza; fa godayis yez shalo ubbayil afa E shuuminttoda.
Zin ye ayllay, ‹Ta goday ellithii ye7enna› yeegii fa wozinar qoppii, gadhinditannee gaachita yhadhdhiko, ma paas kozheez garkk miitarannee uzhittar mathiko,
ye ayllay goday E qoppekka gallasaninnee hirggekka wode ye7oda. Yi7ii eza gashichii, e anija ammanoowa asitayir oothoda.
«Goday shenay garkk giigozayinnee e goday ab qadhdhizako erittar oothowa ayllay gaame garafinttoda.
Zin fa goday shena erekka attii garafinttodayis beezizana ootheezay xiqqal garafinttoda. Abis giiko gaame inggintteezaypp gaame koyinttiza, gaame hadara ekkeezayppekka gaame immad gi naaginttiza.»
Sarotithis baazin shaakinttosii
«Taanii ye7eezay biittal afa tama aythodayis. Yhatti tamay aykkizako tana wayizii ufayssoddeshsha!
Hano zin, ta yhatti xammaqinttiza xinqqatay yeza. E polinttod gatho ta waafa un77inttodeshsha.
Sa7all afa sarotithi ko7odayis ye7eeza yinttis aazinee? Yeya baaya, ta ye7eezay shaakkodayis.
Yhattepp aykkii woli gancce shaakintteez ichchin asay pettii keetha wolla yeza. Nam7ittay hayidzitayil afa, hayizitayikka nam7itayil afa, denddii shaakinttoda.
Aday na7ayil afa, na7aykka adayil afa, indat na7attil afa, na7ata indatil afa, azinnay indat na7ay machchatil afa, na7ay machchat azinnay indatil afa, dendii shaakinttoda.»
Laythita malloba
Maakka asayiko, «Awa gelo baggar salo shaaratiza wode bi7ii, ellis, ‹Ira ye7oda› yi yeegiza, yey garkkekka haniza.
Sulle bagga carkko carkkiza wode ‹Sa7ay awoda› yi yeegiza, yey garkkekka haniza» yeegeeza.
Yinttano, cubbitayyo, Salobazinnee sa7abaz shaakkii erizin yha woda shaakkii eroday yinttan wayizii gameenee?
«Yeezin, yi ubbas abis tuma pirddoosa?
Ne morkkayir wolla dayina tiina eqqodayis yhanigittar ogel afa giigodayis koyii. Ne giigekka attiko gooshichchi daynna tiina nena kammada. Daynnay nena poolisees aathii immada. E nena woyne oloda.
Si7oytta, pettii bakkanna attekazin ciggi haassod gatho ne izipp kezaamizanno eroba» yeegeeza.
